dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: So... this is it? This is your boat?

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: It's really, uh... compact. But, it works... It's about the right size for sweeping up junk from the water's surface.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Only thing is... we're packed in like sardines here. There's nowhere to put my guitar...

dialogues.speaker: Beidou
dialogues.text: Uh, Xinyan, your "axe" is getting a little too close for comfort...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh! Whoops! Lemme try to move that out of your way...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Huh? Umm Xinyan, why does your guitar have blades on it?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Self-defense, of course! It shoots fire, too! ...Oh, but the middle of a big festival probably isn't the best time to give you a demonstration...

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Also, there's a teeny-tiny chance it might set your boat on fire... That's not a risk worth taking, no matter how small...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, this gal really jazzed up her guitar...
